description.zh: 创建、定制和管理插件：脚手架、组件 schema（skills / agents / hooks / MCP）、连接器配置与模板适配。部分上游技能假设 Cowork 桌面环境，本地使用时按通用插件规范在工作区内输出。
description.en: Create, customize, and manage plugins: scaffolding, component schemas (skills / agents / hooks / MCP), connector configuration, and template adaptation. Some upstream skills assume the Cowork desktop environment; locally they deliver results as workspace files.

welcome_message.zh: 想为团队定制一个插件？从描述需求开始
welcome_message.en: Want a plugin tailored to your team? Start by describing the need

zh: 帮我从零创建一个新插件：清单、skills 目录和连接器说明
把这个插件改造成适配我们团队工具链的版本
检查我插件清单里的 MCP 配置写法，指出问题并给出修复
en: Scaffold a new plugin from scratch: manifest, skills directory, and connector docs
Adapt this plugin to our team's toolchain
Review the MCP configuration in my plugin manifest, flag issues, and suggest fixes

description.zh: 从零脚手架清单、技能和连接器
description.en: Scaffold a manifest, skills, and connectors

prompt.zh: 帮我从零创建一个新插件：清单、skills 目录和连接器说明
prompt.en: Scaffold a new plugin: manifest, skills directory, and connector docs

description.zh: 在现有插件上适配团队工具链
description.en: Adapt an existing plugin to the team's tools

prompt.zh: 把这个插件改造成适配我们团队工具链的版本
prompt.en: Adapt this plugin to our team's toolchain

description.zh: 审查清单里的 MCP 配置写法
description.en: Review the MCP configuration in a manifest

prompt.zh: 检查我插件清单里的 MCP 配置写法，指出问题并给出修复
prompt.en: Review the MCP configuration in my plugin manifest, flag issues, and suggest fixes

description.zh: 补一个可复用技能：场景、步骤、交付
description.en: Add a skill with trigger, steps, and output

prompt.zh: 请为这个插件写一个技能。先问清目标用户和要用的工具类别，再写触发场景、步骤和交付物。
prompt.en: Write a skill for this plugin. Ask who it's for and which tool categories it needs, then specify the trigger, steps, and deliverable.

description.zh: 只写工具类别和待填字段
description.en: Document tool categories and fields to fill in

prompt.zh: 请为这个插件补连接器说明：只写工具类别和需要用户填写的字段，不要编造端点或凭据。
prompt.en: Document connectors for this plugin: tool categories and fields the user must fill in. Do not invent endpoints or credentials.

description.zh: 检查技能、子智能体和钩子是否齐全
description.en: Check skills, agents, and hooks for gaps

prompt.zh: 请审查这份插件清单：skills、agents、hooks 和 MCP 配置是否齐全，字段是否符合规范，并指出要改的地方。
prompt.en: Review this plugin manifest: are skills, agents, hooks, and MCP config complete and valid? Point out what to change.
